description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the correlation between different knowledge popularity metrics and two categories—"Movies" and "Songs"—with the y-axis labeled "Correlation" ranging linearly from 0 to 0.7, and the x-axis displaying the categories "Movies" and "Songs" in order. The chart contains four distinct bar types, each representing a different popularity metric: "PopGT" (solid orange), "PopGe" (hatched orange), "RPopGT" (solid blue), and "RPopGe" (hatched blue), as indicated by the legend. For the "Movies" category, the "PopGT" bar reaches approximately 0.22, the "PopGe" bar is slightly lower at about 0.11, the "RPopGT" bar is at approximately 0.35, and the "RPopGe" bar is the tallest at about 0.63. In the "Songs" category, the "PopGT" bar is approximately 0.30, the "PopGe" bar is around 0.10, the "RPopGT" bar is at about 0.50, and the "RPopGe" bar reaches approximately 0.70, which is the highest value shown on the chart. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each category, with no explicit sorting, and the tallest bars correspond to the "RPopGe" metric across both categories. A gray bar is present at the far right of the x-axis but lacks a label or corresponding legend entry.
